scope: public-fixture mathematical leakage and software replica simulation; no TEE or privacy claim

softmax.interpretation: A row shift and permutation retain all sorted gaps and the probability multiset; they do not hide the distribution.

rms.interpretation: Positive scaling preserves the normalized vector up to permutation when epsilon is zero. Public epsilon*r^2 with known nonzero epsilon reveals r.

gelu.interpretation: Permutation and dummy padding retain the original values in a visible multiset; this is not cryptographic masking.

wire_model.accounting: sum of directed WAN application bytes across all parties
